caption:
Desi Animal Fries 
C: 54 | F: 32 | P: 50
Calories: 711 per bowl
Makes one bowl that can be shared by 2 

Ingredients
2 - 3 Potatoes, cut into fries
1/2 cup milk
2 cheese slices
1/2 tsp red chilli powder + 1/2 tsp black pepper
1 green chilli, finely chopped
120 grams chicken kheema ( recipe in my chicken kheema dosa recipe) | paneer bhurji would be tasty tooo
handful of coriander

Method
Air fry your french fries
make the cheese sauce by combining the milk and cheese slices in a pan and heat on low heat till the cheese melts and forms a sauce, it will thicken as it cools 
add in the powders and green chilli and set aside
add the fries to a bowl, top with kheema and cheese sauce and fresh greens and enjoy
